title.zh: UK opens a major loophole for stablecoin payments while clamping down on crypto lending

current_state.zh: HM Treasury laid a draft statutory instrument that would exempt qualifying stablecoin transfers and cash exchanges from certain dealer permissions while keeping return-right crypto lending and swaps within the regulatory perimeter.
